opennyai_summary.decision:
Both the parties are seeking quashing of the case FIR No.0340/2022 registered under sections 376/436 of the Indian Penal Code 1860 and section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act 2012 by consent.
Considering the allegations in the FIR, before proceeding further with the matter, the Investigating Officer is directed to place on record a copy of the chargesheet.
Parties are directed to remain present in court on the next date.
